per_view.notes: Slender grey tube with blunt squared nose and flat tail; no nose taper or upswept tail cone. Front hump with windows present, partial length. Wing is only a thin flat dark sliver. Two boxy nacelles near belly. Nose wheel plus clustered main wheels on thin struts. No vertical or horizontal stabilizers, only a thin antenna-like line. Uniform flat grey.

Slender grey tube with blunt flat tail cone. Front hump with upper-deck windows and main-deck window row present. Wings read as thin flat slabs; two boxy nacelles visible below. No vertical fin — only a wire-thin diagonal line and a small flat stub at the tail. Nose wheel plus clustered mid wheels on thin struts.

Head-on: four dark-inlet nacelles hang under wings with clear dihedral and plausible spacing. Small darker upper lobe with a dark windshield band suggests the hump. Thin vertical fin and small tailplane bars visible. Nose strut plus only two visible main struts with tiny wheels. No passenger window lines or doors; coherent grey scheme; assembly looks clean.

Rear head-on: circular fuselage with small crown bump, four nacelles under dihedral wings with plausible spacing but faint pylons. Vertical fin is a thin unswept rod; no horizontal stabilizers visible. Sparse gear struts with tiny wheels. Uniform flat gray, zero surface detail, no windows or livery. Wings read as thin slabs.

Slender tube fuselage with rounded nose, cockpit mark, front-third hump outline, and dashed window rows. Wings render only as hairline swept lines with no visible chord or taper; four boxy nacelles at plausible spacing appear to float. Tail surfaces are thin lines. Planform silhouette lacks the 747 wing entirely.

Slender grey tube with flat blunt nose cap and no tail cone. Wings are thin stick-like rods with slight sweep, no chord or taper. Three visible cylindrical nacelles, one mounted above the fuselage on a rod, two below near the stick wing. Tail surfaces are bent wire lines. Evenly spaced window row present. A few tiny floating wheels; monochrome grey.

Slender tube with front-third hump bearing upper-deck windows and a main-deck window row. Rear ends in a blunt flat disk, no tail cone. Wings are wire-thin swept sticks; four small nacelles sit near them, two appearing to float behind the trailing edge without pylons. No tall vertical fin visible; only thin stick stabilizers. Tiny wheels under mid-body. Uniform gray.

Long slender grey tube with flat blunt nose disc and cut-off tail. Subtle low hump over front third. Wings are razor-thin swept slabs, no visible thickness, taper, or clear dihedral. Two to three cylinder nacelles on thin struts; four not confirmed. Nose strut plus mid wheel clusters present. Even window dashes; all-grey monochrome scheme.

critic.fix_suggestion: Improve 'Empennage (tall vertical stabilizer + horizontal stabilizers)' (mean 3.38/10). Target the 8 anchor: single tall swept vertical stabilizer plus swept horizontal stabilizers at the tail cone, plausible sizes; then the 10 anchor: correct 747 empennage: very tall swept fin, low-mounted swept tailplane pair with dihedral, all tapered and proportioned to the fuselage.
